theme: 全真模擬考 第 3 回

words.ex: The committee will evaluate every application.
The seminar was postponed until Thursday.
You are eligible for the exchange program.
The university adopted a no-smoking policy.
The deposit is two months' rent.
Early cancellations get a full refund.
Please bring a printed handout to class.
She applied for a visa extension.
That match was the turning point of the season.
Residents are responsible for cleaning the kitchen.

audio.t: How long does it take to get a transcript printed?

questions.explain: 問的是「需要多久」，(B) 回答「通常約三天」最恰當。(A) 回答地點；(C) 回答價錢，都答非所問。

audio.t: Would you like to join our study group for the economics final?

options: Sure, when do you usually meet?
I studied economics in high school.
questions.explain: 對方邀請加入讀書會，(A) 接受並詢問聚會時間，最自然。(B) 重複 final、(C) 重複 economics，都是關鍵字陷阱。

audio.t: Who's in charge of booking the seminar room?

options: The room on the second floor.
You should ask Mr. Lin in the department office.
questions.explain: 問「誰負責」預約研討室，(C) 指出要找系辦的林先生。(A) 重複 booked 但回答時間；(B) 回答位置。

audio.t: Why weren't you at the lab meeting this morning?

questions.explain: 問「為什麼沒出席」，(A) 說明有看診預約，是理由。(B) 回答地點、(C) 回答時間，都不是原因。

audio.t: Is the cafeteria open during the winter break?

questions.explain: 問寒假期間餐廳有沒有開，(C)「只有平日有開」直接回答。(A) 重複 break、(B) 重複 winter，都是字面陷阱。

audio.t: Have you handed in the reading report yet?

options: Not yet, I'm still checking the references.
questions.explain: 問報告交了沒，(B) 說還沒、還在檢查參考資料。(A) 說「讀了兩次」答非所問；(C) 用 hand 做字面陷阱。

audio.t: Where should I put these returned projectors?

options: On the cart next to the door.
questions.explain: 問投影機要放哪裡，(A) 回答「門邊的推車上」。(B) 用 project 與 projector 相似音；(C) 用 returned 且以 Yes 回答 Where 問句，不合理。

audio.t: Should we print the posters or just post them online?

options: Let's do both, to reach more people.
questions.explain: 選擇疑問句（印海報或只放網路），(B) 回答「兩者都做」合理。(A) 用 post 做同字陷阱；(C) 說已印好且用單數 it，與問題不符。

audio.t: Do you know if Professor Wu has office hours today?

options: She does, from two to four.
questions.explain: 問吳教授今天有沒有 office hours，(C) 說有、兩點到四點。(A) 重複 know；(B) 重複 hours 但談花費時間。

audio.t: The registration system is down again.

options: Really? Then I'll try again later tonight.
questions.explain: 對方說選課系統又當機，(B) 回應「那我晚點再試」最自然。(A) 與系統當機無關；(C) 把 down 誤會成樓層位置。

audio.t: How about meeting in the student lounge instead of the library?

options: That works. We can talk freely there.
questions.explain: 提議改在學生交誼廳見面，(A) 同意並說明可以自由交談，最恰當。(B) 從 library 聯想借書；(C) 只提到 lounge 的椅子，沒有回應提議。

audio.t: Which elective are you taking next semester?

options: I elected him as class leader.
I'm still choosing between art history and film studies.
questions.explain: 問下學期修哪門選修，(C) 說還在藝術史與電影研究之間選擇。(A) 重複 next semester；(B) 用 elected 與 elective 相似音。

audio.t: Hi, I'd like to return this calculator I borrowed from the math department.
Sure. Oh, it's three days late. There's a fine of ten dollars per day.
Three days? I thought it was due tomorrow.
It was due on Monday. You can pay at the cashier on the first floor.

questions.prompt: How much will the woman most likely pay?
questions.explain: 逾期三天、每天罰十元，共三十元，選 (D)。(A) 只是每日罰金；(C) Thirteen 與 Thirty 發音相近，是常見陷阱。

audio.t: Attention, students. Due to the typhoon warning, all classes after twelve noon today are cancelled. The library will close at two p.m. The cafeteria will remain open until six for students living in the dormitories. Please check your university email for updates about tomorrow's classes.

questions.prompt: What will stay open the latest today?
questions.explain: 餐廳開到六點，比圖書館（兩點關）晚，選 (A)。(C) 下午課程已停課；(D) 宿舍辦公室廣播中沒有提到。

audio.t: Excuse me, is this the line for the bus pass?
No, this line is for parking permits. Bus passes are sold at window three, but they don't open until one thirty.
Oh, it's only one o'clock. I guess I'll grab lunch first.

questions.prompt: What will the man probably do next?
questions.explain: 男子說 "I'll grab lunch first"，接下來會先去吃午餐，選 (C)。(B) 三號窗口一點半才開，是之後才做；(A) 這排是停車證，他不需要。

audio.t: Did you hear? The guest lecture by the novelist has moved from the auditorium to room three oh two.
Room three oh two? That's tiny. How many people signed up?
Only about forty, so it should be fine.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply about the lecture?
options: Fewer people signed up than expected.
questions.explain: 女子用 "Only about forty" 暗示報名人數比預期少，所以小教室就夠，選 (B)。(A) 講座只是換教室並未取消；(C) 對話沒有提到禮堂整修。

audio.t: Professor Kao, I missed the quiz on Tuesday because I had a fever. Can I take it later?
Do you have a doctor's note?
Yes, from the campus clinic.
Then bring it to my office on Thursday, and you can take the quiz right after class on Friday.

questions.prompt: When will the student take the quiz?
questions.explain: 教授說星期五下課後補考，選 (D)。(A) 星期二是原本錯過的小考；(C) 星期四是交診斷證明的時間。

audio.t: Hello, this is Grace from the International Student Office. We received your visa extension application, but your passport photo is missing. Please drop off two photos at our office before Wednesday, or the application cannot be processed. Thank you.

questions.prompt: What does the listener need to do?
options: Bring two photos to the office
questions.explain: 留言請對方週三前送兩張照片到辦公室，選 (A)。(B) 只提到護照「照片」，不是換護照；(C) 申請已收到，不必重填。

audio.t: This printer keeps jamming. I've lost three pages already.
That one's been broken for weeks. Use the one in the computer lab next door; it's faster anyway.
Do I need to log in again there?
Yes, with your student ID number.

questions.prompt: What does the man suggest?
options: Asking for a new ID number
questions.explain: 男子建議改用隔壁電腦教室的印表機，選 (B)。(A) 沒有提到叫人修；(D) 只說要用學號登入，不是申請新號碼。

audio.t: The Student Chorus will hold its winter concert on December twelfth at seven p.m. in Grand Hall. Tickets are free for students but must be picked up in advance at the Student Activities Center. Each student may get up to two tickets. Guests from outside the university can buy tickets for one hundred dollars at the door.

questions.prompt: What is true about the tickets?
options: They are only sold at the door.
Students can pick up at most two.
They are available on December twelfth only.
questions.explain: 每位學生最多可領兩張票，選 (C)。(A) 一百元是校外人士票價；(B) 學生票要事先到課外活動中心領；(D) 十二月十二日是演出日期，不是只在當天發票。

audio.t: Are you going to the career fair this Saturday?
I wanted to, but my part-time job schedule changed. Now I work Saturday mornings.
The fair runs until five, though. You could come in the afternoon.
Oh, then I'll go after my shift.

questions.prompt: What will the woman most likely do on Saturday?
options: Go to the fair in the morning
questions.explain: 女子最後說 "I'll go after my shift"，下班後去徵才博覽會，選 (D)。(A) 原本想放棄但改變主意；(B) 是排班被改，不是她要改；(C) 早上她要上班。

audio.t: Hi, I'm calling about the room for rent near campus. Is it still available?
Yes, it is. The rent is eight thousand a month, including electricity, but water is extra.
And is there a deposit?
Two months' rent.

questions.prompt: What is included in the rent?
questions.explain: 房東說月租八千「含電費」，選 (B)。(A) 水費另計；(C) 押金是另外收兩個月租金。

audio.t: Before we begin, a reminder: your lab reports are due next Monday, not Friday as written in the syllabus. Also, please note that from next week, our class will meet in the new science building, room one fifteen.

questions.prompt: What change does the speaker mention?
options: The due date for the lab reports
The topic of the next class
questions.explain: 說話者提醒實驗報告截止日改為下週一（不是課綱寫的週五），選 (A)。另一項變更是上課地點，但選項中沒有；(B)(C)(D) 都沒有提到。

audio.t: Good morning, and welcome to the teaching assistant orientation. I'm Professor Helen Lu from the Center for Teaching. This semester, more than sixty graduate students will work as T A's in over twenty departments, so let me cover the basics.

First, your hours. Each T A works ten hours a week. This includes leading discussion sections, holding one office hour, and grading. If you find that grading takes much longer than expected, talk to the course instructor first, not to our center.

Second, training. All new T A's must complete two online modules before October first. The first is about classroom safety, and the second is about fair grading. You'll find both on the university learning platform.
Finally, please remember that you cannot grade the work of a student who is a close friend or family member. If this happens, tell your instructor so another T A can grade that work.
After this session, please pick up your T A badge at the table near the exit. Your badge also lets you use the staff photocopier free of charge.

questions.prompt: Who should a TA talk to first if grading takes too long?
questions.explain: 講者說改作業太花時間時要 "talk to the course instructor first, not to our center"，選 (B)。(A)(D) 正是她說不要先找的教學中心。

questions.prompt: What topics do the online modules cover? (Choose TWO.)
questions.explain: 兩個線上課程分別是課堂安全與公平評分，選 (A)(C)。(D) 學習平台只是上課程的地方，不是主題；(B)(E) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What can TAs do with their badge?
options: Get a discount at the bookstore
questions.explain: 最後提到助教證可以免費使用教職員影印機，選 (C)。其他選項都沒有提到。

audio.t: Health Center, how can I help you?
Hi, I saw a poster about free flu shots for students. Do I need an appointment?
For the free shots, yes. They're given only on November eighteenth and nineteenth, in the gym, and you need to book a time online.
I have exams on both of those days. Is there any other option?
You can come to the Health Center any weekday after that, but then it's not free. It costs three hundred dollars.
Hmm. What time are the gym sessions?
From ten a.m. to four p.m. Each shot only takes about ten minutes, including the short wait afterward.
Oh, my exam on the nineteenth ends at eleven. I could go after that.
Then book a time on the website. And don't forget to bring your student ID and your health insurance card.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?
options: To ask about getting a flu shot
To report that she is sick
To ask about her exam results
questions.explain: 女子看到免費流感疫苗海報，打來詢問如何施打，選 (B)。(A) 她還沒預約；(C) 沒說生病；(D) 考試只是時間衝突的原因。

questions.prompt: What problem does the woman mention at first?
options: She lost her health insurance card.
She cannot afford three hundred dollars.
She has exams on the vaccination days.
questions.explain: 她一開始說 "I have exams on both of those days"，與施打日期衝突，選 (D)。(C) 三百元是工作人員提供的替代方案費用，她沒說付不起；(A)(B) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What will the woman most likely do?
options: Go to the gym after her exam on November 19
Pay for a shot at the Health Center
questions.explain: 她十九日的考試十一點結束，打算考完去體育館施打（十點到四點），選 (A)。(B) 是付費方案，她最後沒選；(D) 十八日她整天有考試。

audio.t: This is Campus Radio with today's top story. Starting next Monday, the university is launching a bike-sharing system called Campus Wheels. Two hundred bikes will be available at twelve stations across campus, including the main gate, the library, and every dormitory.

Students can rent a bike using the university app. The first thirty minutes are free, and after that, it's five dollars for every additional thirty minutes. The service runs from six a.m. to midnight.

Why the new system? According to the Office of General Affairs, the number of scooters on campus has nearly doubled in three years, causing parking problems and safety concerns. The university hopes bikes will reduce traffic and also encourage students to exercise.
Riders must return bikes to a station, not leave them outside buildings. Anyone who leaves a bike outside a station three times will lose access to the service for one month.

questions.prompt: How much does it cost to use a bike for one hour?
questions.explain: 前三十分鐘免費，之後每三十分鐘五元，騎一小時共五元，選 (B)。(A) 只適用於前三十分鐘；(C) 是誤把六十分鐘都計費。

questions.prompt: What are the reasons for starting the service? (Choose TWO.)
options: To raise money for new stations
questions.explain: 廣播說學校希望單車能減少校園交通量並鼓勵學生運動，選 (B)(E)。(A)(C)(D) 都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What happens to riders who leave bikes outside a station three times?
options: They must take a safety class.
They cannot use the service for a month.
questions.explain: 三次未把車還到站點，將停權一個月，選 (D)。罰款、安全課程、學生證停用都沒有提到。

audio.t: In today's class, we'll look at something psychologists call the bystander effect. It describes a surprising pattern: the more people who see someone in trouble, the less likely any one of them is to help.

In a famous series of experiments in the nineteen sixties, students were asked to sit in a room and fill out a form. Then smoke began to enter the room. When students were alone, most of them left to report the smoke within a few minutes. But when they sat with two other people who ignored the smoke, only about one in ten reported it.

Why does this happen? One reason is that responsibility is shared. Each person thinks someone else will act. Another reason is that we look at others to decide what is normal. If nobody else seems worried, we assume there is no emergency.
The good news is that simply knowing about the bystander effect makes people more likely to help. So if you ever need help in a crowd, point to one specific person and ask them directly.

questions.prompt: What happened when students were in the room with two people who ignored the smoke?
options: They asked the others for advice.
Few of them reported the smoke.
They stopped filling out the form.
questions.explain: 與兩位忽視煙霧的人同處一室時，只有約十分之一的人回報，選 (C)。(A) 是「獨自一人」時的情況，是時間情境錯置的干擾。

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, why do people fail to help?
options: They believe someone else will act.
They are afraid of getting hurt.
They do not know how to help.
questions.explain: 講者說原因之一是責任分散："Each person thinks someone else will act"，選 (A)。其他三項都不是講者提到的原因。

questions.prompt: What does the speaker recommend doing when you need help in a crowd?
questions.explain: 講者建議在人群中求助時，指著某一個人直接請他幫忙，選 (D)。(C) 等人注意正是旁觀者效應會造成的問題。

questions.prompt: The scholarship committee will ______ each application based on grades and volunteer experience.
questions.explain: evaluate「評估」，委員會依成績與志工經驗評估申請，選 (A)。evacuate 撤離、elevate 提升、eliminate 淘汰，語意不合。

questions.prompt: Because the speaker's flight was delayed, the seminar was ______ until next Thursday.
questions.explain: be postponed until...「延期到…」，選 (C)。preserve 保存、prevent 預防、propose 提議，都不能與 until 下週四搭配。

questions.prompt: Please keep your receipt as ______ of payment in case there is a problem with your registration.
questions.explain: 空格在 as 之後、of 之前需要名詞，proof of payment「付款證明」，選 (B)。prove 是動詞、proven 是過去分詞；approval「核准」語意不合。

questions.prompt: The professor asked us to ______ the main ideas of the article in no more than two hundred words.
questions.explain: summarize「摘要」，用兩百字內摘要文章重點，選 (D)。summon 召喚、assume 假設、consume 消耗，語意不合。

questions.prompt: Dormitory residents are ______ for keeping the shared kitchen clean.
questions.explain: be responsible for...「負責…」，選 (B)。respectful 有禮貌的、responsive 反應快的、reasonable 合理的，都不接 for + V-ing 表負責。

questions.prompt: The new study rooms are ______ to all students, but they must be reserved at least one day in advance.
questions.explain: be available to...「可供…使用」，選 (A)。valuable 有價值的、avoidable 可避免的、variable 多變的，語意不合。

questions.prompt: To be ______ for the exchange program, applicants must have a GPA of at least 3.0.
questions.explain: be eligible for...「有資格參加…」，選 (D)。visible 可見的、flexible 有彈性的、edible 可食用的，都是字尾相似的干擾。

questions.prompt: The lab assistant gave us clear ______ on how to use the microscope safely.
questions.explain: instructions on how to...「如何…的指示」，選 (C)。construction 建造、inspection 檢查、introduction 介紹，語意不合。

questions.prompt: Due to the small room size, club membership is ______ to fifty students per semester.
questions.explain: be limited to + 數量「限於…」，選 (A)。listed 列出、linked 連結、located 位於，都不能表示人數上限。

questions.prompt: Many students find it hard to ______ their time between part-time jobs and schoolwork.
questions.explain: balance A between B and C「在 B 與 C 之間平衡時間」，選 (B)。blame 責怪、borrow 借、bother 打擾，語意不合。

questions.prompt: The university ______ a new policy that bans smoking anywhere on campus.
questions.explain: adopt a policy「採行政策」，選 (D)。adapt 改編／適應 與 adopt 拼字相近是主要陷阱；admit 承認、adjust 調整也不合。

questions.prompt: If you have any questions about the assignment, feel free to ______ me by email.
questions.explain: contact me by email「用 email 聯絡我」，選 (C)。concern 涉及、contain 包含、contract 簽約，字形相近但語意不合。

reading.title: Water Supply Interruption: Maple Hall and Pine Hall
passage: Due to pipe replacement work, there will be no water supply in Maple Hall and Pine Hall on Wednesday, November 26, from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Residents are advised to store water the night before. Bottled water will be available free of charge in the lobby of Oak Hall, which will not be affected. The shower rooms in the sports center will also be open to residents of both halls from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. that day.
If the work cannot be completed on time, a notice will be posted on the Housing Office website by 4:00 p.m. Questions may be sent to housing@univ.edu.tw.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of this notice?
options: To ask residents to save water
To inform residents about a temporary water stoppage
To introduce a new housing website
questions.explain: 公告主旨是兩棟宿舍因換管線將暫時停水，選 (C)。(A) 運動中心淋浴間是既有設施的開放；(B) 是建議前一晚儲水，不是節約用水；(D) 網站只是公布後續消息的地方。

questions.prompt: Where can residents get free bottled water?
questions.explain: 免費瓶裝水在 Oak Hall 大廳發放，選 (A)。(B) Maple Hall 是停水的宿舍；(C) 運動中心提供的是淋浴間。

reading.title: Change to Presentation Schedule
head: From: Dr. Sandra Weng
To: Students in Marketing 201
Subject: Change to presentation schedule
passage: Dear all,

Because of the university sports day on December 3, our class that day is cancelled. Group presentations originally planned for December 3 will now take place on December 10, together with the groups already scheduled for that date. Each group will therefore have 12 minutes instead of 15.
Slides must still be uploaded by 9 p.m. the day before your presentation. Groups presenting on December 10 should also bring one printed copy of their handout to the start of class.
Best regards,
Sandra Weng

questions.prompt: Why is the December 3 class cancelled?
options: A campus event is taking place.
questions.explain: 信中說因為十二月三日是校運動會，所以停課，選 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 信中都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What is true about the presentations on December 10?
options: Slides can be uploaded during class.
Only groups from December 3 will present.
Groups must bring a printed handout.
questions.explain: 十二月十日報告的組別要帶一份紙本講義，選 (D)。(A) 時間縮為 12 分鐘；(B) 投影片要前一天晚上九點前上傳；(C) 原本排在十日的組別也會一起報告。

reading.title: Text Messages
passage: Kevin (10:42): Hey, are you still in the library? I left my calculus notebook on the third floor, near the window.
Mia (10:44): I'm on the second floor, but I can check. Blue cover?
Kevin (10:45): Yes! I need it for the quiz at 1. Can you bring it to the cafeteria at noon?
Mia (10:52): Found it. But I have a club meeting at noon. I'll leave it with the security guard at the library entrance instead.
Kevin (10:53): Perfect, thanks! I'll get it on my way to class.

questions.prompt: What does Kevin ask Mia to do?
options: Bring his notebook to the cafeteria
Help him study for a quiz
Meet him on the third floor
Return a book to the library
questions.explain: Kevin 問 "Can you bring it to the cafeteria at noon?"，選 (A)。(B) 小考只是他需要筆記的原因；(C) 三樓是他遺落筆記的地點。

questions.prompt: Where will Kevin most likely pick up his notebook?
questions.explain: Mia 中午要開社團會議，改把筆記交給圖書館入口的警衛，Kevin 也同意去拿，選 (C)。(A) 是 Kevin 原本的請求，但 Mia 無法配合。

reading.title: Lost and Found Claim Form
passage: Name: Lin Yu-ting    Student ID: B11203045
Item lost: Black umbrella with a wooden handle
Date and place lost: November 6, Lecture Hall B (afternoon)
Description: Folding type; small white sticker with the letter "Y" on the handle

Claim procedure: Bring this form and your student ID to the Security Office (Administration Building, Room 105) between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. on weekdays. Items are kept for 30 days. Unclaimed items will be donated to charity.

questions.prompt: How will the security staff most likely identify the owner's umbrella?
options: By the place it was found
By a mark on its handle
questions.explain: 表單特別描述把手上有寫著 "Y" 的白色小貼紙，這是最能辨識的特徵，選 (D)。(A) 黑色雨傘很普遍，無法確認失主；(C) 雨傘上沒有日期。

questions.prompt: What will happen to items not claimed within 30 days?
options: They will be given to charity.
They will be sold to students.
They will be moved to another office.
questions.explain: 表單寫 "Unclaimed items will be donated to charity"，選 (B)。donate 捐贈 = be given to charity；其他選項都沒有提到。

reading.title: Call for Entries: 5th Campus Short Film Festival
passage: Have a story to tell? The Film Society invites all current students to submit short films for our annual festival, to be held on January 8 in the Arts Center.

Films must be no longer than 10 minutes and must have been made within the past year. Films in any language are welcome, but those not in English must include English subtitles. Each person may submit up to two films.
Submit your film online by December 15. The top three films will receive cash prizes of NT$10,000, NT$5,000, and NT$3,000, and an audience award will be decided by votes on the festival night.

questions.prompt: What is a requirement for films?
options: They must be at least ten minutes long.
They must be submitted in person.
Each team may submit only one film.
questions.explain: 非英語影片必須附英文字幕，選 (A)。(B) 是「不超過」十分鐘；(C) 要線上投件；(D) 每人最多可投兩部。

questions.prompt: How will the audience award be chosen?
options: By votes on the night of the festival
By the number of online views
questions.explain: 觀眾獎由影展當晚的投票決定，選 (C)。(A) 電影社是主辦單位；(D) 線上只是投件方式，與觀看次數無關。

reading.title: Debate Club Finds Success by Listening More
passage: When Chen Wei-lun joined the university debate club two years ago, the team had not won a single national competition in a decade. This October, the club took first place at the National University Debate Championship, beating 31 other teams.

According to Chen, now the club's captain, the turning point came when the team changed how it trained. "We used to spend most of our practice time writing speeches," he said. "Now we spend half our time listening to the other side's arguments and summarizing them before we respond." The club also began inviting students from other departments, such as law and engineering, to act as practice opponents.

Coach Lisa Fang believes the new method made team members calmer during competitions. "Good debaters don't just speak well. They notice what the other side has missed," she explained. She also pointed out that the club's membership has grown from 12 to 35 students since last year.

The team will represent the university at the Asian Debate Open in Singapore next March. Because travel costs are high, the club is asking for donations and will hold a public practice debate on December 5, with all ticket money going to the travel fund.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: How a debate team improved its results
Why debate is useful for law students
The rules of a national debate competition
How to raise money for student travel
questions.explain: 全文描述辯論社改變訓練方式後奪得全國冠軍，主旨是 (A)。(B) 法律系學生只是練習對手之一；(D) 募款只是最後一段的細節。

questions.prompt: What change did the team make in its training?
options: It practiced only with law students.
It spent more time listening to opponents.
It hired a new coach from Singapore.
questions.explain: 社長說現在花一半時間聆聽並摘要對方論點，選 (B)。(A) 還有工學院等其他科系，不只法律系；(C) 寫講稿是以前的做法；(D) 新加坡是明年比賽地點。

questions.prompt: The phrase "turning point" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: turning point 指「轉折點」，即情況開始改變的關鍵時刻，選 (C)。從上下文「改變訓練方式之後開始贏」可推知。

questions.prompt: What will happen on December 5?
options: The team will fly to Singapore.
The club will hold a debate to raise money.
questions.explain: 十二月五日將舉辦公開練習辯論，門票收入全數作為旅費，選 (D)。(A) 去新加坡是明年三月；(C) 全國賽已在十月結束。

reading.title: Sharing a Room with Someone from Across the World
passage: When I found out my new roommate was from Brazil, I was excited but also nervous. My English was fine for class, but I wasn't sure I could live with someone who did everything differently.

The first few weeks were not easy. Lucas liked to cook late at night and play music while studying, while I preferred silence. We had a few small arguments, mostly about noise. Then our resident advisor suggested we write a "room agreement" together. We decided on quiet hours from 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. and agreed that whoever cooked would clean the kitchen the same night.

Once the rules were clear, things got much better. Lucas taught me to make a Brazilian dish called feijoada, and I took him to the night market to try stinky tofu. He hated it, but he still talks about it. By the end of the semester, my spoken English had improved more than in three years of classes, simply because we talked every day.
My advice for anyone with an international roommate: don't wait for problems to get bigger. Talk early, write things down, and be curious. You may end up with a friend for life, as I did.

questions.prompt: What caused problems between the writer and Lucas at first?
questions.explain: 作者說爭執 "mostly about noise"，選 (B)。(C) 作者說自己英文上課沒問題，擔心的是生活習慣不同；(A)(D) 沒有提到。

questions.prompt: Who suggested the room agreement?
questions.explain: "our resident advisor suggested we write a room agreement"，是宿舍輔導員提議的，選 (D)。(A)(B) 是一起寫協議的人，但不是提議者。

questions.prompt: What does the writer say about stinky tofu?
options: It is the writer's favorite food.
It was sold out at the night market.
questions.explain: "He hated it"，Lucas 不喜歡臭豆腐，選 (C)。(A) Lucas 教作者做的是巴西菜 feijoada；(B) 文中沒說是作者最愛。

questions.prompt: What is the writer's main advice?
options: Discuss problems early with your roommate
Ask to change rooms if you disagree
questions.explain: 最後一段建議 "don't wait for problems to get bigger. Talk early"，選 (A)。其他選項都與作者經驗或建議相反或未提及。

reading.title: Graduation Photo Sessions on Campus
passage: The Student Affairs Office has partnered with Bright Studio to offer graduation photo sessions on campus from March 2 to March 20. All sessions take place in the Student Center, Room 210, and include the use of graduation gowns and caps.
Students who book before February 15 receive a 10% discount on any package. Group sessions are for 3 to 6 students, and the price shown is per person. Extra printed photos cost NT$150 each.

To book, visit the Student Affairs website and choose a time slot. Payment must be made at the time of booking. Cancellations made at least 3 days before the session will receive a full refund; later cancellations will receive a 50% refund.

questions.prompt: Where will the photo sessions take place?
options: In Room 210 of the Student Center
questions.explain: 文章說所有拍攝都在學生活動中心 210 室，選 (C)。(A) Bright Studio 是合作的攝影公司，不是拍攝地點；(B) 學務處是合作單位。

questions.prompt: Which package includes a photo album?
questions.explain: 表格中只有 Premium 方案的紙本照片欄寫 "4 + photo album"，選 (D)。

questions.prompt: A student books the Standard package on February 10. How much does the student pay?
questions.explain: 表格：Standard 方案 NT$1,500；文章：二月十五日前預約打九折，1,500 × 0.9 = 1,350，選 (A)。(B) 是原價，忽略了早鳥折扣。

questions.prompt: Four friends book a group session together on February 20. What is the total price?
questions.explain: 團體方案每人 NT$900，四人共 3,600；二月二十日預約已超過二月十五日，沒有折扣，選 (B)。(C) 3,240 是誤套九折；(A) 只是一人價格。

questions.prompt: A student who paid the full price cancels a Premium session one day before it takes place. How much will be refunded?
questions.explain: Premium 方案 NT$2,600；前一天取消不足三天，只退一半，2,600 × 50% = 1,300，選 (D)。(B) 是三天前取消才有的全額退款。
